description_en: The ScanOssObjectV1 operation creates a scan task to detect sensitive data in a specified object
description_zh: 调用ScanOssObjectV1接口为对应存储对象创建敏感数据识别的扫描任务
kebab_example: aliyun sddp scan-oss-object-v1 --service-region-id cn-hangzhou --bucket-name sddp-api-demo-bucket --object-key-list dir1/object.txt --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScanOssObjectV1

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the OSS bucket is located
parameters.help_zh: 服务地域ID，即OSS Bucket所在的地域ID
parameters.name: service_region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket
parameters.name: bucket_name

parameters.help_en: A list of objects to scan in the OSS bucket. You can specify up to 50 ObjectKeys
parameters.help_zh: 待扫描的OSS Bucket中存储对象列表，一次最多可输入50个ObjectKey
parameters.name: object_key_list

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the industry-specific template.

Call DescribeCategoryTemplateList to get a list of templates. If you do not specify this parameter, the default active template is used for the scan
parameters.help_zh:
行业模版ID。

可调用DescribeCategoryTemplateList获取模版列表，如不填本参数，默认使用主用模板来进行扫描
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

Id.description_en: The ID of the scan task. This is returned after the task is successfully created
Id.description_zh: 创建识别任务成功后，返回的识别任务ID

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use it to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
